verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com (HTTP 200) that describes itself as structured access to AWS documentation for large language models. Per-service llms.txt files exist (for example, the Resource Groups user guide), and individual doc pages are served as .md files (DynamoDB Local, service lifecycle, EC2 Query-Requests), so an agent can be pointed at machine-friendly docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, first-party guidance on how to use llms.txt with agents, and the root-level .md probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
